subject: FluxScale onboarding: invoice consolidation, PO flow, and flexible net terms
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@fluxscale.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@fluxscale.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: FluxScale onboarding: payment terms / PO flow

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the welcome — excited to get FluxScale set up as a Redwood supplier. A couple items from our side to align on before we submit docs: 

- Current preferred terms: Net 45 due to our customer billing cadence.
- We can offer an early-pay discount if Redwood can commit to a 15-day accelerated remit option (1.5% discount).
- We prefer monthly consolidated invoicing (one invoice per month, by cost center).

We're attaching our onboarding packet and W-9. Can you confirm:
1) whether Redwood can accept Net 45 for initial 3 months while we finish PO routing?
2) how the PO / invoice routing should be formatted so accounting can match quickly?

Attached: FluxScale_onboarding_packet.pdf, FluxScale_W-9.pdf

Best,
Anna Lopez
Head of Finance Operations
FluxScale Inc.
anna.lopez@fluxscale.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@fluxscale.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FluxScale onboarding: payment terms / PO flow

Hi Anna — thanks for sending the packet. Looping in David (payments) and Marissa (vendor onboarding) to scope next steps. Quick answers up front:

- Redwood standard is Net 30, but we can be flexible during onboarding. We can accept Net 45 for the first 60 days while PO mapping completes.
- We run a centralized PO system; best practice is: include our PO# in the invoice subject line and the GL code in the invoice body (see our onboarding checklist link below).

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) FluxScale confirms whether consolidated monthly invoices will include line-level PO references (yes/no).
2) FluxScale completes Redwoods vendor form (we'll send a DocuSign).
3) Redwood creates initial PO and issues one-time onboarding PO to cover the first 30 days.
4) Payments team to evaluate early-pay enrollment: we offer a pilot (15-day early pay) with a 0.75% discount; alternative is a 15-day accelerated remit at 1.5% (as you proposed) but that requires CFO approval.

Can you complete the onboarding form by Wednesday so Marissa can start PO creation? I attached the onboarding checklist for reference.

Onboarding checklist: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4821

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

Hi Priya,

Appreciate the flexibility. A few clarifications from our CFO: 
- We can include PO references at the line level for consolidated invoices (yes).
- We'd like to target Net 45 as the standard going forward; the early-pay offer is attractive — I'll run the 1.5% figure by our CFO and see if we can accept the 0.75% pilot if Redwood prefers.

Attached is our earlypay_request.xlsx showing cashflow windows and preferred invoice dates. We'll complete the DocuSign vendor form today.

Thanks — Anna

Anna — thanks for the packet and the early-pay sheet. Quick note from payments ops after a brief internal review: 

- We will approve Net 45 as the ongoing standard for FluxScale given consolidated invoicing and PO mapping.
- We can onboard FluxScale into our 15-day early-pay program at 0.75% discount for the first 90 days to validate the cadence. After the pilot we'll re-evaluate and can consider the 1.5% structure if your CFO signs off.
- Please complete the vendor DocuSign and upload the signed W-9 to the DocuSign envelope.
- PO creation: Marissa will create a master PO and then issue monthly invoice POs tied to that master PO. Please ensure each monthly invoice includes the master PO number and line-level references for faster remittance.

Next steps summary:
- FluxScale: sign DocuSign packet; upload W-9 (invoice_monthly@fluxscale.com can submit).
- Marissa: create master onboarding PO after DocuSign is complete.
- Payments: enroll FluxScale in 15-day early-pay pilot once PO is live.

I've attached the onboarding_checklist.xlsx with the PO field requirements and our preferred invoice CSV template. I'll also kick off the DocuSign envelope (https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABCD1234).

Thanks,
David Kim
Payments Manager
